pm.test("Les deux paiements sont présents", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(p => p.idPaiement); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get("paiementId"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get("paiementSecondId"))); });

pm.test("Paiements conservés", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().paiements.map(p => p.idPaiement); pm.expect(ids).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get("paiementId"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get("paiementSecondId"))); });
